# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.2.0] - 2024-03-15

### Changed
- Updated MATLAB module to R2024a
- Added MATLAB Parallel Server support for multi-node jobs

### Fixed
- Fixed MATLAB license checkout timeout on GPU nodes

## [1.1.0] - 2023-11-01

### Added
- Added support for MATLAB Compiler Runtime

### Changed
- Increased default walltime to 8 hours for MATLAB batch jobs

## [1.0.0] - 2023-06-01

### Added
- Initial release of the MATLAB interactive app
- Support for R2023a and R2022b
